mapper.insert: INSERT INTO claim (item_id, user_id, verify_mark, verify_location, verify_time, status) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{userId}, #{verifyMark}, #{verifyLocation}, #{verifyTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT c.claim_id AS claimId, c.item_id AS itemId, c.user_id AS userId, c.verify_mark AS verifyMark, c.verify_location AS verifyLocation, c.verify_time AS verifyTime, c.status AS status, c.create_time AS createTime, i.item_name AS itemName, i.image_url AS imageUrl, u.student_id AS studentId, u.email AS email FROM claim c LEFT JOIN item i ON c.item_id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.status = 'pending'

SELECT c.claim_id AS claimId, c.item_id AS itemId, c.user_id AS userId, c.verify_mark AS verifyMark, c.verify_location AS verifyLocation, c.verify_time AS verifyTime, c.status AS status, c.create_time AS createTime, i.item_name AS itemName, i.image_url AS imageUrl, u.student_id AS studentId, u.email AS email FROM claim c LEFT JOIN item i ON c.item_id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.status != 'pending' ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.claim_id AS claimId, c.item_id AS itemId, c.user_id AS userId, c.verify_mark AS verifyMark, c.verify_location AS verifyLocation, c.verify_time AS verifyTime, c.status AS status, c.create_time AS createTime, i.item_name AS itemName, i.location AS location, i.occur_date AS occurDate, i.image_url AS imageUrl, i.intent AS intent FROM claim c LEFT JOIN item i ON c.item_id = i.item_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status != 'deleted' ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE claim SET status = 'deleted' WHERE claim_id = #{claimId}
